adoptionRule: Do not turn DentalGest into a generic ERP. Adopt only common organization patterns that strengthen the dental product.
businessRole: Dental clinic SaaS with clinical records, appointments, treatments, invoices and dental inventory.

betaDecision.siatPolicy: Internal billing, payments, balances and export readiness from day one. Live SIAT fiscal emission stays gated until provider/authorization/testing responsibilities are validated.

entityMappings.notes: Clinic staff profile and role layer already exist.
Could represent reception, clinical, billing, lab and management, but not required for clinical MVP.
Patients are clinical domain records, not generic contacts. Avoid flattening clinical data into core contacts.
Clinical appointments and treatment follow-up can surface as work items without replacing their domain models.
Useful for recalls, treatment plans, lab follow-up, consent and billing routines.
Evidence must respect clinical privacy and stay tied to dental domain rules.
AuditLog can satisfy activity history after contract alignment.
Could support patient or inventory import with strict validation.

blockedUntil: Dental-specific workflows defined before generic task UI
Fiscal/SIAT provider, authorization and testing responsibilities validated before live fiscal emission
